summary: fix(settings): Nova dark-mode and mobile visual fixes
description:
Because:

* Review of the Nova design system turned up small dark-mode and mobile issues

This commit:

* Adds Acorn ghost-button hover/active fills to the modal close button
* Fixes copy-button contrast and the near-white focus fill in dark mode
* Insets the InputText focus ring over its border, as moz-input-text does
* Fixes confetti stacking, footer logo in dark mode and Google icon centring
* Stacks a settings row's two CTAs on mobile

Closes #FXA-15126
